evidence: The bug concerns Split View hidden-attribute handling in tab groups during session restore, which maps to Frontend's Firefox::Tabbed Browser: Split View/Tab Groups (with Core::Session Restore as fallback).
The bug is in the DevTools Inspector computed panel and references OutputParser, so the fix belongs to DevTools.
Unified trust panel icon driven by site identity/ETP state maps to Firefox::Site Identity and Protections UI, owned by Privacy Engineering.
The report concerns the crashreporter client, which maps to Toolkit::Crash Reporting, owned by OS Integration.
The crash is in nsAnimationManager and CSS animation collection lifetime, matching Layout's Core::DOM: Animation/CSS Transitions and Animations ownership.
Bug concerns `.urlbar-input-box` styling, which lives in Firefox::Address Bar, a component owned by Search Next Generation.
Scroll-snap selection/snap-target selection is implemented in APZ, covered by Core::Panning and Zooming which the Layout team owns.
The Windows-specific RegisterWaitForSingleObject/CloseHandle misuse in ~KeyWatcher maps to Core::Widget: Win32 under OS Integration.
Crash is in CDMInformation::ToObjectInternal via UtilityMediaServiceChild::GetKeySystemCapabilities, i.e. EME/CDM media code exercised by eme tests.
The report only asks to revert a fix for another bug and names no component, code area, or symptom to route on.
The proposed fix is in nsZipCursor::ReadOrCopy, which is jar/zip handling code owned by Core::Networking: JAR.
The report involves EventStateManager's pointer-lock mouse coordinate tracking and pointer event handling, owned by Core::DOM: UI Events & Focus Handling under DOM Core.
The bug concerns search-specific default-engine Glean probes not updating on search engine name changes, owned by Firefox::Search.
Debug assertions and crash all point to layout fragmentation code (nsColumnSetFrame.cpp, nsFlexContainerFrame.cpp, nsLayoutUtils.cpp frame-tree completeness), owned by the Layout team.

The assertion originates in xpcom/base/ClearOnShutdown.cpp (Core::XPCOM / shutdown-phase machinery, owned by OS Integration), with CookieService (Networking) being lazily initialized past its shutdown phase inside a backup test (Frontend).
The crash is in dom/indexedDB/ActorsParent.cpp, and Core::Storage: IndexedDB is owned by DOM LWS.
The report concerns Firefox's Application settings UI rows after a settings redesign, owned by Frontend.
Bug is in nsWindowWatcher chrome-flag/popup-feature logic (Core::Window Management, owned by Frontend) triggered by window.open modifiers.
The bug is about the 'Server Not Found' error page template and its 'Learn More' link, which is Toolkit::Error Pages, owned by the Frontend team.
The bug is in browser/components/urlbar and browser/actors/UrlbarParent, matching Firefox::Address Bar owned by Search Next Generation.
The crash is in nsPipe in mozilla/xpcom (nsICloneableInputStream/Core::XPCOM IO), which is owned by the OS Integration team, with Networking/DOM: Streams as consumers of Clone().
Perfherder alert is a DAMP (DevTools) regression in browser-toolbox.inspector-ready, pointing at the DevTools team's tooling.
The report asks to remove a border on the RDM toolbar, owned by DevTools::Responsive Design Mode.
The clipped asset is the securityError illustration used by toolkit/content/net-error-card.mjs, i.e. Toolkit::Error Pages, which is owned by Frontend.
FocusManager and DOMMenuItemActive focus-handling match Core::DOM: UI Events & Focus Handling owned by DOM Core.
The file SERPCategorization.sys.mjs belongs to Firefox Search, owned by Search Next Generation, with the hash update only a supporting detail.
The report targets IPC ParamTraits for WidgetEvent in widget/nsGUIEventIPC.h, which falls under Core::IPC/Core::Widget owned by OS Integration (with type-confusion security relevance).
Bug is a use-after-munmap race in dom/canvas/DrawTargetWebgl.cpp's WebGL surface upload path, owned by Core::Graphics: CanvasWebGL/Canvas2D under GFX.
SearchWidgetTracker and search-container widget placement point to Firefox::Search owned by Search Next Generation.

Failure is a build-system dependency/ordering error in `mach build`/gmake, not a runtime product bug, so it lands with build tooling (CI and Quality Tools), with Javascript possible since the missing header feeds js/src.
The report concerns a WebAssembly Memory64 bounds-check bug, which maps to Core::JavaScript: WebAssembly owned by Javascript.
The crash is in SpiderMonkey's Intl.Collator code path (js/src/builtin/intl/Collator.cpp / js::intl::CompareStrings), owned by Core::JavaScript: Internationalization API under the Javascript team.
Favicon request is triggered by the built-in PDF viewer (Firefox::PDF Viewer, owned by CI and Quality Tools), with favicon/Places handling and cookie/credential context as nearby candidates.
SVG animateMotion path tests (Core::SVG) are owned by the Layout team.
The report lacks details about the underlying component of Bug 2046258, making routing impossible.
The bug is about the tracking protection panel's UI, owned by Firefox::Protections UI under Privacy Engineering, with HCM styling pointing to shared widgets as a secondary possibility.
The bug concerns the Firefox VPN (IP Protection) status checkbox in the overflow menu, and the IP Protection component is owned by Frontend.
Crash is in js/src/wasm/WasmPI.cpp/WasmModule.cpp for WebAssembly.promising, matching Core::JavaScript: WebAssembly owned by Javascript.
Crash occurs in gfxAndroidPlatform::IsFontAPIDisabled / gfx/thebes/gfxAndroidPlatform.cpp, the platform font API code owned by Core::Graphics: Text under GFX.
The null-dereference is in accessible/xul/XULFormControlAccessible.cpp, which belongs to Core::Disability Access APIs under Accessibility.
The root cause is in servo/components/style/rule_cache.rs and @starting-style cascade handling, covered by Core::CSS Parsing and Computation under Layout.
The report targets the CC/Address/Password doorhanger and Edit address panel, i.e. Form Autofill/Password Manager UI owned by Credential Management.
Talos tp5o_scroll_paint_skip/tscrollx regressions on macOS under the 'webrender' option point at Core::Graphics: WebRender, owned by GFX.
Build bustage in masm.callWithABI<Fn, jit::InitBaselineFrameForOsr> points to the JavaScript engine JIT code.
JXL image decoding is handled by Core::Graphics: ImageLib, which is owned by GFX; the PGO build detail only narrows the environment, not the owning team.
DecodePropertyIPDL is IPDL-generated deserialization code, and Core::IPC is owned by OS Integration.
RemoteMediaDataEncoderChild and RemoteCDMChild are part of the Gecko Media Plugin / EME media stack (Core::Audio/Video: GMP / Playback).
Heap overflow is in ANGLE's CopyBGRA8ToRGBA8Fast/PackPixels, which maps to Core::Graphics: ANGLE owned by GFX.
The bug names nsSocketTransport::InitiateSocket and HappyEyeballsConnectionAttempt, which are Necko socket transport code owned by Networking.
The failing path is FOG/StartupTelemetry initialization (Services.fog.initializeFOG / initFOG), which is Toolkit::Telemetry code.
Mobile-only failure to scroll nested tab content points to the scrolling/overflow layout code owned by Layout.
Crash originates in nsTextFrame::GetSelectionDetails (layout/generic/nsTextFrame.cpp), a layout text-frame code path reached while building WebRender commands.
The leak is in widget/gtk/nsGtkKeyUtils.cpp, which maps to Core::Widget: Gtk owned by OS Integration.
Stack trace crashes in nsIFrame::CorrectStyleParentFrame / RestyleManager first-line reparenting, i.e. layout/generic and layout/style code owned by the Layout team.
The report concerns the media-triage-bot's message formatting and mentions Media+AI=padenot.
The test path mentions 'webrtc' and mDNS candidate obfuscation is part of WebRTC ICE, owned by Media.
The bug is in widget/cocoa/MOZDynamicCursor.mm, which falls under Core::Widget: Cocoa owned by OS Integration.
Symptom is a hang after authenticating and redirecting to a Terminal Server/RDP web gateway (HAR attached), pointing at the HTTP auth/WebSocket networking stack rather than page rendering.
ConfirmationHint is a Firefox browser frontend panel widget (browser/base/content) whose auto-hide/popup behavior falls under Firefox frontend UI ownership.
The failure is service-worker interception of a fetch from a dedicated worker, and both Service Workers and Workers components are owned by DOM LWS.
The crash is in gfx/wr/webrender/src/prepare.rs, which is covered by the GFX team's WebRender component.
Bug concerns the Firefox::IP Protection (VPN) panel showing the wrong screen after a CFR dismissal, both owned under Frontend/Messaging.
PDF viewer text-selection rendering is the failing surface, and the report asks for a fallback when backdrop-filter is disabled/blocklisted.
Bug is in dom/reporting/ReportDeliver.cpp (Reporting API/DeprecationReportBody), a core DOM implementation area owned by DOM Core, with a privacy-leak angle as secondary.

Crash site is dom/file/MutableBlobStorage.cpp, the DOM Blob/File implementation owned by Core::DOM: File (DOM LWS), with IPDL actor lifecycle semantics as the secondary angle (Core::IPC under OS Integration).
The failing test is about the computed value of 'animation-duration' via CSS Typed OM (stylePropertyMap), which maps to core CSS animation/CSSOM components owned by Layout.
The warning originates in widget/gtk/ScreenHelperGTK.cpp, which is covered by Core::Widget: Gtk, owned by OS Integration.
Assertion failure in js/src/wasm/WasmTypeDef.h during Ion WebAssembly compilation (Core::JavaScript: WebAssembly).
The report is about the HTML adoption agency algorithm, handled by Core::DOM: HTML Parser under DOM Core.
The bug is about Firefox Messaging System impression telemetry (messaging_system.message_id) from a Spotlight/Tab Groups Promo, owned by the Messaging System component.
ASan heap-use-after-free in harfbuzz font metrics reached via gfxFont::GetBaseline, i.e. text shaping / font handling (Layout: Text and Fonts, with Graphics: Text as the render-side fallback).
The report points to HTTP/2 RST_STREAM handling and NS_ERROR_NET_RESET in Core::Networking: HTTP, owned by Networking.
Crash frames are in modules/libjar (nsJARChannel::GetContentTypeGuess / nsJARProtocolHandler), which the Networking team owns via Core::Networking: JAR.
Bug concerns searchbar search behavior (ContextualSearch vs TabToSearch), which is owned by the Firefox search/address-bar team.
querySelector is a DOM API, and an infinite loop in its selector-matching implementation points to DOM Core.
Print output color-mode bug maps to Core::Printing: Output/Setup, owned by Layout.
Screen reader fails to read a Firefox UI link, matching the Accessibility team's Firefox::Disability Access component.
RTCDTMFSender.cpp is WebRTC DTMF signaling code, matching Core::WebRTC: Signaling under the Media team.
The bug involves Firefox profile selection and profiles.ini corruption, matching Toolkit::Startup and Profile System owned by Frontend.
Crash stack is in dom/media/webspeech SpeechRecognitionParent, and Core::Web Speech is owned by Media.
The report targets the private-browsing behavior of the shield/trust panel's 'Clear Data' option, which is owned by Privacy Engineering's Protections UI and Private Browsing components.
The bug involves tab group dragging and split view UI behavior, owned by Frontend components Firefox::Tabbed Browser: Split View and Tab Groups.
The failing test is test_wasm_offthread_compile.html, which exercises WebAssembly off-main-thread compilation owned by Core::JavaScript: WebAssembly.
